asset_scan_limits: All 105,357 indexed .uasset payloads in 35 local PAKs were decompressed and scanned for readable name-like ASCII and ASCII-range UTF-16LE strings; this establishes string-scan coverage only.

A corrected ReadScriptData=true Ue4Export pass exported all 105,357 provider-visible *.uasset packages to 105,357 JSON files. All files decoded, and the export completed with zero warnings after temporary null-safe guards for UEnum.WriteJson and UAssetImportData.SourceData. The full census covered 494,268 objects, 16,579 functions with bytecode, 209,339 top-level expressions, and 654 filtered community/recruitment call references. The temporary parser edits were used only in the external analysis copy and are not shipped.

The event analysis follows serialized EventIndexes and ElseEventIndexes from mission-record event arrays. Named EventName dispatch, all lifecycle activation paths, and native/virtual call control flow are not yet resolved.
Some CommunityMembers condition exports omit Comparison. Their class-default value and runtime meaning remain unknown; the report does not guess.

Direct native call analysis remains bounded to decoded function ranges and selected targets; virtual/indirect calls and ProcessEvent/delegate dispatch remain unresolved; a full .pdata census now enumerates direct E8/E9 edges to 160 selected targets.
Save/load, migration, UI capacity, and above-cap gameplay behavior remain runtime questions and were not tested.
All 105,357 full-export JSON files are retained only as external temporary data; the repository keeps compact audit and call-reference reports, not copied game assets.

structured_asset_path_coverage.method: Normalized case-insensitive .uasset paths from asset_index.json and the global, path-candidate, symbol-candidate, and mission selection reports; duplicate PAK path entries are counted once.

full_uasset_export.interpretation: All provider-visible packages were exported and BOM-aware decoded with zero warnings. The full serialized Blueprint call census found 654 filtered community/recruitment references across 167 targets. It includes 3 TryAddCharacterRecord calls (CinematicFunctionLibrary.AddNPCToCommunity and two CheatMenu callers) and no direct CanAddCharacter/CanAddCharacters Blueprint call tokens. This census is complete for parsed serialized expression forms, not for native/virtual/delegate dispatch or runtime reachability.

Decoded bounded native recruitment targets and confirmed the recorded direct CALL/tail-jump edges.
Ran the isolated recruitment machine-code emulation and repository consistency checks.
Inventoried top-level EventName reuse across all 131 parsed MissionAsset packages; repeated labels remain observations and are not traversed as execution edges.

Revalidated all 3,798 global keyword-hit assets against the warning-free full export; selected JSON and bytecode counts remain 67,209 objects, 5,170 functions, and 59,087 top-level expressions.
Exported and decoded all 105,357 provider-visible .uasset packages with zero warnings; full package coverage contains 494,268 objects, 16,579 bytecode functions, and 209,339 top-level expressions.

Completed the all-package serialized community/recruitment call census: 654 references across 167 targets; 3 TryAddCharacterRecord references and no direct CanAddCharacter/CanAddCharacters Blueprint call tokens.

Decoded every executable .pdata function range (259,728) once and fully enumerated direct CALL/JMP edges to 160 selected targets; independently cross-checked all 109,914 E8 candidates with zero unmatched sites.
Censused every serialized CommunityMissionCondition object across the full 105,357-package export: 315 objects in 19 packages, 46 missing Comparison fields, with zero JSON errors.

Scanned the fixed executable's non-executable sections for Comparison enum name pointers; found six names in a contiguous qword group and recorded the order as an ordinal candidate, without claiming a numeric value array or default.

Decoded the fixed-build Comparison enum initializer and its CHAININFO-linked helper fragments: the initializer passes the seven-name table and a null explicit-value pointer; the helper's fallback stores each loop index in its enumerator record. Recorded the sequential numeric mapping as strong static inference, while leaving the omitted struct-field default unresolved.

Scanned exact ASCII and UTF-16 condition-related names across all 259,728 executable .pdata ranges; found one direct code reference to the CommunityMissionCondition suffix inside a UCommunityMissionCondition UTF-16 name, at 0xA2F92B in range 0xA2F8F0–0xA2F987. The name-bearing function passes class-registration-style arguments to 0x11A4680; this locates a native class-name use but not the class-default property value.

Decoded the UCommunityMissionCondition initializer and its CHAININFO-linked native registration/property constructors. Static initializer-chain evidence associates Comparison (offset candidate 0x28), Value (0x2C), and ComparisonStat (0x30) with a 0x38 registered-size argument; the separate UMissionCondition registration has a 0x28 size argument. This narrows the field layout but does not recover the CDO value or prove a C++ inheritance edge.

Expanded the unique native function catalog with 20 mission-event lifecycle candidates, decoded 282 registration entries, and enumerated 18 serialized mission-event lifecycle call references across the full package export.
unresolved_static: Resolve the native CommunityMissionCondition class-default Comparison value: the full export contains 315 serialized instances in 19 packages, with 46 missing Comparison fields (43 CommunityMembers, one CommunityOutposts, and two with no serialized ComparisonStat). The enum initializer strongly supports Equal=0, and the native property initializer places Comparison at offset 0x28; however, the CDO or constructor default has not been recovered, so Equal-as-default remains unproven.

Follow named EventName dispatch, mission scheduling/activation, and all event lifecycle links beyond explicit EventIndexes/ElseEventIndexes. The full export finds seven InitializeEvent factory call sites but no serialized calls to condition checking or state/outcome wrappers; registered wrappers have no direct E8 callers, so reflection/virtual/delegate dispatch and ordering remain unresolved.

Resolve native indirect/virtual/ProcessEvent/delegate dispatch and calls to targets outside the selected 160-RVA direct-call census; direct E8 caller sets for selected targets are now completely enumerated.
Establish exact roster storage, serialization, and all consumer semantics from decoded structures/functions rather than names or bounded callers.
requires_runtime: Confirm above-cap recruit, save/load, community transitions, UI selection/layout, exile, transfer, and follower systems in game.

key_findings: CanAddCharacter and CanAddCharacters native wrappers call separate internal player-enclave checks; their direct callers were instruction-confirmed.
GetLivingCharactersCount reaches shared population helper 0x27D150, which has 58 confirmed direct call sites. Faking this global count would affect unrelated gameplay systems.
IsPastPopulationSoftCap is a separate query from the hard recruitment gates.

TryAddCharacter and TryAddCharacterRecord reach separate roster append routines. The append implementations have 2 and 12 verified direct call sites respectively; one additional tail jump reaches the record routine.
Restore-exiled and character-transfer paths contain separate population decisions and are covered by dedicated guarded patch sites.

The full .pdata census resolves high-fanout direct CALL caller sets for its selected 160 targets; this replaces the earlier bounded caller sample for direct E8 edges but does not cover indirect dispatch or targets outside that set.
limits: Direct-call reports only include E8/E9 instruction edges recovered from bounded executable function bodies.
Virtual calls, indirect calls, ProcessEvent, delegates and data-driven dispatch are not enumerated as direct edges.
Call graph edges do not prove runtime reachability, UObject ownership, call semantics, or save/load invariants.

asset_findings.conclusion: Removing the population gate must preserve mission locks and permanent recruitment restrictions.
Legacy recruitment has a capacity state independent from whether the legacy pool contains survivors.
The asset exposes array/pool management and layout-specific operations; it does not prove arbitrary-size UI, selection, camera, or inventory behavior.

Structured cooked exports show mission-authored CommunityMembers conditions remain separate from the native eligibility patches. Four explicitly serialized <=11 branches and one <=10 branch connect to RecruitCharacter events targeting PlayerCommunity; a sixth connected condition has Value=11 but no serialized Comparison, so its meaning is unresolved. These story routes are not changed by the native-only cap patches and disprove a blanket claim that every scripted recruitment path is unlimited.
asset_findings.capacity_wrapper_call_scope: Only 1,500 selected path/symbol candidate exports; absence here is not evidence that all 105,357 packages lack such calls.

evidence: PopulationManagerBp.uasset contains PopulationLimit=6, but its exact player/NPC scope is not established.
Legacy and Community assets contain bIgnoresPopulationCap and LegacyEnclaveCap properties with differing values.
The Builder legacy asset includes cast roles CommunityNPC01 through CommunityNPC12; these are mission cast identifiers, not proof of a twelve-entry save roster.
asset_findings.conclusion: Do not globally rewrite population getters, every literal 9/12, or all cap-related asset properties.

observations: The complete exported JSON tree contains 315 CommunityMissionCondition objects across 19 packages; 269 serialize Comparison and 46 omit it.
Of 211 conditions explicitly tagged CommunityMembers, 43 omit Comparison. The additional full-tree objects extend beyond the 266 conditions in the selected MissionAsset packages.
The census also finds one omitted CommunityOutposts comparison and two objects without a serialized ComparisonStat.
limits: Serialized omission does not reveal the native CDO default or prove that every condition instance is reachable in a campaign.
The count covers all package exports and includes test, Heartland, boon/bane, ambient, enclave, and legacy assets; it is distinct from the MissionAsset-only event graph census.

implementation_boundary.behavior: Player-enclave recruitment-capacity gates are bypassed at identified native paths while real population counts, NPC checks, and unrelated rejection flags remain intact.
not_proven: Roster save/load, migration, cloud synchronization, or arbitrary roster size after reload.
Correct UI layout, selection, portraits, leader promotion, exile, inventory, follower dispatch, and legacy-pool transfer above twelve members.
Every scripted, mission-authored, radio, or enclave-specific path permits recruitment above twelve.
Community growth beyond twelve has no engine-side storage or subsystem limit.
implementation_boundary.release_statement: The fixed-build native recruitment-cap patches are statically identified and emulated. Real gameplay, save/load, and above-cap subsystem behavior remain unverified because this phase did not run or attach to the game.

validation.test_boundary: The recruitment emulation test runs copied, hash-verified routines with controlled callbacks in a private test allocation; it does not start, attach to, or modify the game process.

blueprint_analysis.parser: Ue4Export/CUE4Parse, Ue4Export revision cf112ad366842f09f43e269914dab5f4d2ee3fcc, CUE4Parse revision cb6fba1bed6d2feaba7e1972b6b5fade9d49fb7b; local exporter configured with ReadScriptData=true

event_name_inventory.interpretation: Name reuse is recorded as descriptive/correlation evidence only. EventName equality is not treated as a unique key or execution edge because dispatch/grouping semantics have not been resolved.

community_condition_comparison_coverage.inference: No explicit Equal value appears among these selected native condition instances. The omitted fields are consistent with Equal being the CDO default, but the native CommunityMissionCondition class default object has not been decoded; this is not a verified default.

blueprint_analysis.resolved_exporter_issue: A valid UserDefinedEnum with Names=null exposed a CUE4Parse JSON writer issue. A temporary null guard serializes Names as an empty object, but non-silent full export still reports a NullReferenceException for CommunityScreenLayoutMode; output JSON is valid, while the failing path and package semantics remain unresolved.

mission_event_initialization_probe.result: The bounded body contains property-marshalling/helper calls; the target of its internal helper call is not symbol-resolved. This does not establish EventName dispatch, condition activation order, or event lifecycle.

call_observations.interpretation_limit: These are serialized call-token observations in the parsed keyword-hit set, not proof of runtime execution, campaign reachability, exclusive callers, or absence from unparsed assets. DynamicPawnSpawner:GetCurrentPopulationMax references concern spawn/population systems and are not treated as player-community capacity calls.
